card.statement:
For any $c\in X_{*}(T)/\mathbf{Z}\Delta^{\vee}(L,T)$ and any $\mathscr{F}$ in $\mathrm{P}_{{G_{\mathcal{O}}}}(\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G},\mathbf{k})$ , there exists a canonical isomorphism

$(\tau_{c})_{*}(t_{c})^{!}\mathscr{F}\xrightarrow{\sim}(\sigma_{c})_{!}(s_{c})^{*}\mathscr{F}$

in $D^{\mathrm{b}}_{\mathscr{S}_{L}}(\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{L},\mathbf{k})$ .
Moreover, this complex is concentrated in perverse degree $\langle 2\rho-2\rho_{L},c\rangle$ .
card.label: Lemma 15.1

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
